items.title: How the voices for ChatGPT were chosen
items.summary: How the voices for ChatGPT were chosen We worked with industry-leading casting and directing professionals to narrow down over 400 submissions before selecting the 5 voices.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI介绍了ChatGPT语音功能的选角过程，通过与专业人士合作从400多名候选人中筛选出最终的5种声音。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容属于产品设计细节，对大模型技术演进或行业应用无实质性影响。
